description: This file contains test scripts for the Coocook schema, including database connection tests, statistics, and foreign key checks, utilizing Test2 framework and DBIx::Class.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Counts the number of records in the database or specific tables.

methods.name: statistics
methods.description: Retrieves database statistics such as counts of various entities.

methods.name: connection
methods.description: Tests various ways to connect to the database schema.

methods.name: fk_checks_off_do
methods.description: Temporarily disables foreign key checks during execution of a code block.

methods.name: fk_checks_off_guard
methods.description: Provides a guard object to disable foreign key checks within a scope.

methods.name: assert_no_sth
methods.description: Asserts that no statement handle is active, used to verify no pending queries.
